notes.title: Update regarding our last Harvest Life announcement
notes.notes:
Hi there!

As you may remember, we delightedly announced last time that we're planning on releasing new updates for Harvest Life. We wanted to treat both Harvest Life and our community to some extra TLC. Following up on that, many of you sent us a lot of feedback and quite a few requests, which went a long way in motivating us even more!

But, unfortunately, we have to tell you today that we won't be able to provide you with new updates at this stage. We're sorry to disappoint you. This was anything but an easy decision for us.
We had to consider several factors.
But the main reason is that we couldn't find a suitable team of developers to continue working on Harvest Life. We were very close to closing a deal with a motivated team, but we had to cancel it at the very last moment. 
As you may imagine, the current Covid-19 situation doesn't exactly make it any easier to finalize such a project.

We really wanted to make another update for Harvest Life. But in the current situation it's just not possible.  Many thanks to all you busy farmers out there. Your feedback and joyous anticipation were a great incentive to us.

If you're still looking for new worlds to discover and farm, we recommend our most recent release Stranded Sails: Explorers of the Cursed Islands. Discover a great mix of farming and adventure in a mysterious world that's becoming even more varied with each content update we publish.
As a little "thank you" for moving to the Cursed Islands we can make you a very special offer: As owners of Harvest Life you can buy Stranded Sails: Explorers of the Cursed Islands for the discounted "Farmer Bundle" price!

Just follow the link to jump straight into your next big adventure:


https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/4237/Farmer_Bundle/


Thank you for your patience and enthusiasm. We hope you'll still enjoy Harvest Life and/or take a trip to the Cursed Islands. In any case, we'll be here for you and listen!

Cheers,

your rokaplay team!

P.S.: Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments or follow our Discord channel: discord.gg/rokaplay

notes.title: Update 2.7.3.: Japanese localization & various fixes
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30958905/ec9bb0c7c1df6991450b123bb4b1b9d029a425fa.jpg

Dear farmers,

Our Japanese hobby farmers now have the opportunity to play the game in their native tongue. We hope this will increase the enjoyment of the game in the "Land of the Rising Sun" as well as inspire those who don't speak English so well. For everyone else we have made various improvements, such as:

Changelog  2.7.3
- Enhanced & improved the tutorial
- Japanese language

Bugs
- Stock all now stocks the additional slot, too
- Game no longer shuts down when over-filling a chest with multiple items at the same time
- Shop and smithery now properly shows the correct costs for all items
- Animation fixes
- Sprinkler no longer turns when deactivated
- Weekday-display sometimes didn't show up properly

notes.title: New Update 2.6.6: Balancing and other fixes
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30958905/6ccd702556c0581da546e3d3d6fee005622bf031.jpg
Dear farmers,

From now on there are closing times for the shops in the village and we added more environmental animals amongst other fixes.  

Changelog 2.6.6 in detail:

- The shop & smithery will now ocassionally offer delivery-quests (announced in the newspaper), this way you can gain gold and empty your stock faster
- We reworked and improved fishing, it should feel more smooth now and the upgrades&skill-level have more impact
- Fences now support three- and four-way junctions
- Steam big picture support
- Steam-Controller support
- Controller support in Editor improved
- We added more environmental animals (rabbits, ducks and fish)


Balancing
- The town's smith and shop are closed on sundays now
- Logs value reduced to 20 (from 25)


Bugs
- Sometimes the player got stuck when declining an escort-mission
- Available escorts and quests weren't available after a game-restart anymore
- Game didn't always show the "Game Saved" notification
- Newspaper related to dog will only appear after rescuing the dog now
- Newspaper-achievement works now properly again
- Clock will no longer show 60 minutes (which it sometimes did before)

notes.title: Update 2.6 - Some major fixes
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30958905/5310353db60281bf3de157faafdfec0f149c3bd4.jpg
Dear farmers,

Many thanks for your new reviews! Please keep writing to us! The reviews are an important source for improvements and motivate us to continue working on the game. This update includes some major bugs that we have fixed. And beware: vegetables decay now if they don't get enough water! 
Here is a detailed overview:


Changelog 2.6.0

- Controller-Support for woodcutting and farm-editor and improved in other areas
- Additional environment animals
- Animals will now fall asleep during the night
- Vegetables will now rot if you don't water or harvest them for several days
- Players can build now benches to nap (not very comfy) on
- Escorts and other missions from the shop, restaurant and smithery will be announced in the newspaper (via a note) now

Graphic
- Additional graphical feedback for users about what is happening

Balancing
- Children won't visit the farm after dusk anymore
- Additional newspaper-entries (easier to get the achievement now)
- Smithery and shop are now closed during the night

Major Bugs
- 4:3 UI bug fixed (in hotfix a few days ago)
- Fishing-tutorial sometimes got stuck (in hotfix a few days ago)
- Players occassionally got stuck while loading into an escort-mission
- "Stock all" now correctly stocks all 4 inventory slots
- Animation bugs
- Dog-Quest couldn't be completed in some occassions due to the dog not being responsive
--

notes.title: New Update 2.5: Italian & Spanish localizations and big polish
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30958905/b8cff7627b562ba4090442fbcc2cab5e3ef0871e.jpg

Dear farmers,

We are happy to announce a new update including new localizations (Italian & Spanish) as well as a big polish. Our improvements in detail:

Changelog 2.5.0

- Improved performance
- 4 new character-models 
- New buildable object: Sprinkler, which use up energy to water your crops
- New buildable object: Well
- New languages: Spanish, italian, traditional chinese
- Added "stock all" button for chests and shop
- Lots of new sounds
- Environment animals
- Hints (from grandpa) can now be deactivated in the options


Graphic
- Graphical rework (performance)
- UI improvements to increase user-experience
- Troughs will now show their fill height (water and fodder)
- New animations & improvements 
- Fence-Gates improved to stand out better
- Week-day window altered so it wouldn't stand out as much
- Rain-Graphic reworked

Balancing
- Shop-sales increased
- Linux savegame problem solved
- Placing the same type decoration on another will not cost any gold anymore, so that the player can decorate the farm the way he wants less costly
- Generator runs slower to make it easier
- Splitting wood into logs will now gain 2 instead of 1 log
- Droplings & Eggs will spawn less often
- Apples cost reduced from 20 to 10
- Player will only wake up automatically during 7am and 8pm
- Berry-bushes cost less but can not be picked as often
- Lumberjack levels up a bit slower
- Animals will follow the player longer after getting fed by hand

Bugs
- (Controller) Volume is updated right away instead of when the options are opened the next time
- (Controller) Volume can now be dropped to 0% properly
- Localization fixes
- Players sometimes accidently fed animals several times in a row
- Players sometimes accidently filled troughs several times in a row
- Intro-carriage runs smoother
- Tutorial-inconsistencies improved and indicator added to show when a player action is required
- Sometimes the spouse wore her old job's mailbag 
- Mouse-Movement adjusted to feedback
- The player's cat will now spawn back at the farm if it was deleted accidently in one of the early versions of the game

In the meantime, if you are interested in getting access to preview versions of our games or our newsletter with lots of insider information, please feel free to put your name on our 100% spam free mailing list on https://www.rokapublish.de/mailing-list .

notes.title: New Update: 2.0 - More languages, system support and fixes
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30958905/808b495597c32329852ce107c1a9778ef4f64e91.jpg

More languages!

 Simplified Chinese localization added
 Dutch localization added


Mac & Linux support! 
We are happy to bring Harvest Life today to Mac and Linux users. 

More Bugfixes!

Flashlight sometimes didn't show when entering the forest during the night
Day-End-Screen didn't show the correct value when it was 1000 or higher
Smith-Quest sometimes didn't give the proper reward
Sometimes the progression windowed showed "0" for some value, they should properly count now
Declining the smith's quest should no longer lead to problems
French Localization fixes
Russian Localization fixes
Overlapping texts 
The dog no longer appears in the catacombs after being freed
Dog-Achievement fixed and will be unlocked upon loading your savegame if you haven't received the achievement before
Food-production-machine displays the correct descriptions now
Bears and skeletons no longer count towards the "defeat wolves" quest

Stay tuned and happy farming!

notes.title: New Update v1.9.5
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30958905/3a41eddd1fa634d00e82b896caf31134226c85ea.jpg

Now you can hire staff for different jobs on the farm and receive active support. You'll probably need the help, because new quests are waiting for you. Visit the blacksmith today and learn more about your first quest: the escort quest! Write us how you find the quest!

Our update comprises:
•	Staff! For a certain amount of money per week you can hire employees that can either go fishing, fill troughs (includes henhouses), water and harvest fields (you still have to plant yourself!) or collect eggs, milk etc.
•	Chests! You can now place chests in the farm editor and use them as storage anywhere and not worry about the items being sold.
•	Escort-Quest! Check the smith from time to time to see if he has a quest for you, more quests like these will come in the future! Tell us what you think about them.
•	Fence-gates will open and close automatically now when player or npcs walk through them. Don't worry about animals escaping anymore!
•	Items in the shop will be sold faster now.


Bugfixes:
•	Sometimes pigs couldn't be ridden.
•	The progress- and daily-overview windows sometimes showed wrong portraits and amounts. The current day in your savegame could still show wrong stats, but they will be correct on the next day.
•	Wells now work correctly as water source.
•	Cabbage are correctly sold in the shop again.
•	Sometimes animals wouldn't drink from the troughs even though they were thirsty.
•	Russian localization and font fixes
•	The generator isn't already upgraded on new savegames anymore (old savegames will still have it upgraded).

notes.title: Significant Update v1.5.9 - We continue to harvest!
notes.notes:
https://media.giphy.com/media/xT1R9ZikCwxuMJVG1i/giphy-downsized-large.gif

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30958905/f30a9d90bb92f68cf1f14714eb7e3c7244568338.jpg
Dear farmers, 
we want to continue working on our game in 2018. Therefore, we start the new year with a new update v1.5.9 that includes various improvements to enhance your farming. We keep rolling up our sleeves for the harvest, what about you guys? Have fun and thanks for all your feedback.

Our update comprises:

- Added more tutorial texts, hints and quest descriptions to help players when something new has to be taken care of
- New Animations
- New Quests
- Improved lighting (darker nights & overall enhanced quality)
- You only need 1 hit to receive wood while woodcutting
- When you've already done the quests for today you won't receive the same quests again and your grandfather will tell you to come back tomorrow
- Plotting-Table scroll-speed decreased
- Actions are shown in red when you can't perform them (because of missing resources)

Bugfixes:
- Berry bushes again denied players to eat their berries, we told them that it's their job and they won't be paid if they won't do it. They are handing out berries now, again!
- You can no longer get stuck in chests
- Sometimes too many villagers spawned when leaving the forest
- Henhouses fulfill the "fill trough" quest now
- The old beehive doesn't falsely show the "harvestable-symbol" anymore before you rescued the bee colony
- Rarely actions could be (even accidently) achieved from too far away
- Night savegame: sometimes the flashlight was missing

... and many more optimizations done and bugs fixed.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30958905/aa2a867dffbf792dc515e41bab087f6ecb87b29a.jpg

notes.title: Big update: Harvest Life 1.5
notes.notes:
Dear farmers.
We are very happy to announce a massive update, called 1.5.5, which will bring several new features, massive enhancements and several bugfixes:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30958905/0af55e57d356a79902d41f0661ff627b11bc1a1e.jpg


 Alternative mouse-control (hold left mousebutton to move), give us your feedback how you like it or how we could improve it!
 New building: Chicken coops! 6 chicken can live in one coop. Chicken will automatically stay close to their coop and each coop has its own trough. You can build them with your plotting table
 4 new characters (playable & npcs)
 Love Interests have unique looks now (old savegames could have rare exceptions)
 Alot new animations for npcs and player-character
 New Quest: Find a new bee-colony for the old beehive on your farm in one of the forests!
 New (dynamic) lighting in houses
 Love Interests will now carry a mailbag when they are delivering mail
 New Achievements
 Steam-leaderboards
 Added watering can & new animation while watering fields
 Trees which are cut down will now remain as stumps until they can be cut again


 Overall movement-speed increased
 Eating will regain health now
 Actions "attack" and "woodcutting" can now be performed faster than before.
 "too hungry for this action" removed completely
 Added apples as price for the wheel of fortune
 Customers won't wait as long for a (unavailable) product anymore and make room for new customers faster
 Customers won't visit on rainy days anymore (children will still come to ride pigs)
 Rainy days (and especially thunder) are more rare now
 Queue for "gained items" display
 Balancing optimizations


Bugfixes:

 Berries can now be properly picked in forests
 Berry-Bushes now properly show the "eating"-action instead of the "harvest"-action
 Animals sometimes didn't drink from the trough even though they were thirsty
 Diagonal movement isn't faster than normal movement anymore
 Stomach rumbling will occur earlier
 Children sometimes didn't appear to ride pigs
 Droppings can now be cleaned when the players inventory is full
 Trees that are chopped now properly reset after a while and can be chopped again
 Dead wolves were "standing zombies" from time to time, they gave up on this halloween prank and will properly play dead now
 Sometimes animals didn't show their correct animation
 Troughs visually looked empty after loading the game even though they were filled
 and many more optimizations done and bugs fixed.


Enjoy and let us know how you like it!

 New Quest: Find a new bee-colony for the old beehive on your farm in one of the forests!
 New (dynamic) lighting in houses
 Love Interests will now carry a mailbag when they are delivering mail
 New Achievements
 Steam-leaderboards
 Added watering can & new animation while watering fields
 Trees which are cut down will now remain as stumps until they can be cut again


 Overall movement-speed increased
 Eating will regain health now
 Actions "attack" and "woodcutting" can now be performed faster than before.
 "too hungry for this action" removed completely
 Added apples as price for the wheel of fortune
 Customers won't wait as long for a (unavailable) product anymore and make room for new customers faster
 Customers won't visit on rainy days anymore (children will still come to ride pigs)
 Rainy days (and especially thunder) are more rare now
 Queue for "gained items" display
 Balancing optimizations


Bugfixes:

 Berries can now be properly picked in forests
 Berry-Bushes now properly show the "eating"-action instead of the "harvest"-action
 Animals sometimes didn't drink from the trough even though they were thirsty
 Diagonal movement isn't faster than normal movement anymore
 Stomach rumbling will occur earlier
 Children sometimes didn't appear to ride pigs
 Droppings can now be cleaned when the players inventory is full
 Trees that are chopped now properly reset after a while and can be chopped again
 Dead wolves were "standing zombies" from time to time, they gave up on this halloween prank and will properly play dead now
 Sometimes animals didn't show their correct animation
 Troughs visually looked empty after loading the game even though they were filled
 and many more optimizations done and bugs fixed.


Enjoy and let us know how you like it!

notes.title: Another new Update v1.0.9
notes.notes:
Attention all prospective farmers! We've published an update with the following changes/contents:

• Highly desired: new movement- & collider-system. Give us your feedback if you like it!
• Some graphic improvements
• Improved target-interaction
• Fence-gates can now be closed while you are standing on the same field (if not blocked)
• Balancing optimizations
• Playerhouse small optimizations
• Small adjustments on starting map (won't affect 1.0.6 and 1.0.7 savegames)

Bugfixes:
• "New day begins" during adventuring in one of the forests caused problems
• wooden bridge gold cost was too high
• numpad controls
• Localization problems (French & Russian)
• some quests weren't fulfilled they were meant to be
• Sound-volume adjustments

and some more minor bugs and optimizations.. 

Your opinion is still important to us! We'll stay tuned - you too?

notes.title: New Update v1.06 available
notes.notes:
Hi, we are happy to receive all your suggestions. Step by step, we try to take every comment into account. In the meantime, we have prepared another update for you with the following  improvements:

- Extend your farm: Buy animals, build fields and decorate! (access via plotting table in your house)
- Enhanced Storage-Interface, allowing you to move 1 or 10 items at once
- Optimized initial farm-layout
- Improved balancing
- Several minor visual improvements
- New floortype (dirt)
- Improved performance
- Eggs can now be eaten, yummy!
- limitation on inventory (99 items) removed
- some textfields have been resized to fit all text
- Game-Icon added

Bugfixes:
- Eggs got collected if inventory is full
- Error if no wares on sale
- Gold displayed incorrectly after loading
- Wrong option displayed if tree is cut down
- Displaced bridge after repair
- Minor bugfixes

Thanks for your comments! All of you aspiring farmers, please continue to write us your suggestions for improvement...
